Name: Scarecrows on Sprinklers
Author: Amichwan
Description:
[b]Scarecrows on Sprinklers[/b]

Optimize your farm space by combining sprinklers and scarecrows into a single tile!
This mod allows you to merge any vanilla sprinkler with any scarecrow to keep your crops watered and protected at the same time.

[b][u]Main Features[/u][/b]

• [b]2-in-1 Utility:[/b] Place a scarecrow on top of a sprinkler (or vice versa) to create a functional combo.
• [b]Pressure Nozzle Support:[/b] Automatically detects if your sprinkler has a Pressure Nozzle equipped when merging.
• [b]Live Upgrades:[/b] You can apply a [i]Pressure Nozzle[/i] directly to an existing combo by left-clicking it.
• [b]Safe Dismantle:[/b] Breaking the combo with a pickaxe or axe returns all original items to your inventory.
• [b]Two Visual Styles:[/b] Choose between [b]Standard Vanilla[/b] sprites or a new [b]Cute[/b] appearance. This setting affects both standalone scarecrows and the new sprinkler combos.

[b][u]Compatibility & Restrictions[/u][/b]

• [b]NOT compatible with the Enricher:[/b] Please note that this mod does not currently support the Enricher attachment.
• [b]Not compatible with custom sprites:[/b] If you are using other mods that replace the textures of vanilla scarecrows or sprinklers, those changes will be ignored when they are part of a combo. The combo will use this mod's specific textures.

[b][u]Preview Video[/u][/b]
Check out the mod in action! This video demonstrates how to combine sprinklers and scarecrows, upgrade them with pressure nozzles, and safely deconstruct them.
